creator: SerakSan
scope: Reviewed editor-authored animation sequences using the existing genuine source-art assemblies. This does not claim extracted ROM animation order, timing, or complete game animation coverage.
rights: Original game artwork: Nintendo / Capcom. Source contributor credits remain separate from the editor code license.

review.method: Visually inspected all 206 supplied whole-boss compositions before selecting explicit state-specific pose lists. Source atlas rows are never automatically cycled.
review.fixedComponents: Mazaal head, Gleerok rocky shell, Octorok body, and Chuchu foot/base use existing sourceParts placements and compositionCrop bounds to keep their fixed component in place. Integer positions also compensate for rounded automatic crop anchoring. Scale and flip changes recalibrate an unmodified Simple recipe.

limitations: The combined Gyorg Pair composition has one flattened pose. Animate red and blue Gyorg as separate complete pieces to control both cycles together.
The two-eye Vaati Reborn shield and two one-arm Vaati Wrath compositions have no matching reviewed pose cycle. They remain available as still poses with movement or Timeline editing.
Transformation and materialization actions hold their last supplied pose. A clipped or partially dissolving sprite is not silently erased to simulate a missing transparent frame.
Sweep, reverse-turn, casting recovery, flashing, and repeating actions are editor choreography using genuine source pixels. Multipart boss assemblies remain editor assemblies.
